title: Uruguayan Sweet Tart
description: A sweet and tangy tart inspired by Uruguayan cuisine. Made with exotic ingredients and a hint of sweetness.

ingredients.name: Exotic Fruit (such as guanabana or passionfruit)
Candy Pieces (such as chopped peanut brittle or caramel)

instructions: Roll out the sweet tart pastry and place it in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
Prick the bottom of the pastry with a fork to prevent it from bubbling up during baking.
Bake the pastry for 15-20 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Allow the pastry to cool completely.
In a separate bowl, mix together the exotic fruit and dulce de leche.
Spoon the fruit mixture into the cooled tart shell.
Sprinkle with candy pieces, if using.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
